causal_diagnosis: The current reward has a dominant success_bonus (mean return 18720) that is paid repeatedly per step when both legs contact the pad with low velocities. This is a non-terminal state predicate that fires every step the condition holds, leading to massive reward accumulation (e.g., 46000 in one episode). The policy exploits this by landing early and then staying on the pad to collect the bonus repeatedly, rather than terminating the episode. This explains the high generated reward (19065) but only 60% success-like terminal rate, because the policy sometimes times out while collecting the bonus.
component_interaction_diagnosis: The success_bonus dominates all other components (dominance_ratio 41.79). Dense progress signals (distance_reward, vertical_speed_reward) are small relative to the objective bonus (dense_to_objective_ratio 0.0011). The engine penalties are mild and do not counteract the farming behavior. The crash_penalty is only applied at termination, so it does not prevent the policy from staying on the pad indefinitely.
action_coverage_diagnosis: All four discrete actions are used (coverage_ratio 1.0). The dominant action is 2 (main engine) at 40.7%, followed by 3 (right orientation) at 35.1%, 1 (left orientation) at 23.7%, and 0 (do nothing) at 0.5%. Since all actions are already used, the issue is not action coverage but trajectory-phase guidance: the policy learns to reach the pad and then stay there, rather than completing the episode.

expert_action_plan_diagnosis: Expert action plan requires: (1) Make completion/objective bonuses one-shot or terminal-aligned so they cannot fire every step. (2) Remove repeatable proxy-success payment modes that can be farmed without episode completion. (3) Keep dense progress signals bounded and smaller than episode-scale objective signals. (4) Add diagnostics for success_flag/objective_bonus. Forbidden edits: do not increase raw per-step action/engine bonuses, do not let objective_bonus exceed roughly one terminal event per episode, do not define success only as a non-terminal state predicate.
